basic_info.description: ** Fantastic Golden Gate Heights Multi-Unit Opportunity! ** Located just steps from Forest Hill neighborhood and completely detached & situated on an oversized lot, this property boasts a superior location with an array of investment options. With a top floor 2br/1ba unit VACANT (....with city and hill views!), it's perfect for a homeowner looking for their own space and added income help, or an investor looking to secure today's market rent for a more attractive investment. A well-designed lower 2br/1 ba unit is rented ($2605 per mo.), and a large garage with space for 3+ cars is (fully) available presenting added space considerations. A lower bonus studio space completes the property tour. Don't miss this one in your search!
